Afterwards the game was [ported](/wiki/Video_game_port "Video game port") to the [PlayStation 4](/wiki/PlayStation_4 "PlayStation 4"), [Xbox Series X/S](/wiki/Xbox_Series_X/S "Xbox Series X/S") and [PlayStation 5](/wiki/PlayStation_5 "PlayStation 5") consoles, and the [Stadia](/wiki/Google_Stadia "Google Stadia") streaming platform, and has also spawned a [mobile](/wiki/Mobile_game "Mobile game") version, *[PUBG Mobile](/wiki/PUBG_Mobile "PUBG Mobile")*, for [Android](/wiki/Android_(operating_system) "Android (operating system)") and [iOS](/wiki/IOS "IOS").
